lastfm.not_linked: {cross} **{user}** hasn't linked a Last.fm account yet — link one with {cmd}.
lastfm.need_link_self: {cross} Link your own Last.fm account first with {cmd}.
lastfm.need_artist: {cross} Name an artist, e.g. `/fm artist` Radiohead.
lastfm.need_album: {cross} Use `/fm album` Artist - Album, e.g. `/fm album` Radiohead - In Rainbows.
lastfm.need_guild: {cross} This one only works inside a server — the boards are per server.
lastfm.chart_usage: {cross} Pick a chart: `/fm chart` artists, `/fm chart` albums or `/fm chart` tracks.
lastfm.index_hint: Only members who have used /fm are ranked — run /fm update to add more of your library.
lastfm.nowplaying_empty: Nothing playing, and no scrobbles yet.
lastfm.link_prompt:
Niko reads your scrobbles straight from Last.fm, so every player counts — Spotify, Apple Music, a CD ripper, anything.

Press **Connect Last.fm**, approve Niko on Last.fm's own page, and the website finishes the link.

-# No password: Niko keeps only the session key Last.fm hands back, and `/fm unlink` deletes it.
lastfm.link_linked:
{tick} Linked as **@{handle}**. Everything under `/fm` reads this account.

Reconnecting proves the account again — use it after renaming it on Last.fm, or if the cards stop finding your scrobbles. `/fm unlink` disconnects it completely.
lastfm.link_unavailable: {settings} Last.fm linking isn't configured on this bot — the owner needs to set `LASTFM_API_SECRET`.
lastfm.recent_empty: No scrobbles yet — play something and it will show up here.
lastfm.whoknows_footer: Ranked from the server index · /fm update adds your top artists
lastfm.whoknows_empty: Nobody here has listened to this artist yet. Try /fm update, or ask others to.
lastfm.crowns_subtitle_line: {ranked} member(s) hold at least one crown here
lastfm.crowns_empty: No crowns here yet — crowns appear once two members have listened to the same artist.
lastfm.taste_empty: No artists in common yet. Either of you can run /fm update to widen the picture.
lastfm.unlinked: {tick} Unlinked **@{handle}**. The session key Niko stored is gone, so it can't read your scrobbles any more — your plays stay on Last.fm, and this server's boards keep the artists they already indexed. `/fm link` connects it again whenever you want.
lastfm.no_account_to_unlink: {cross} You don't have a Last.fm account linked, so there's nothing to unlink. `/fm link` connects one.
lastfm.indexing: {loading} Reading your top artists from Last.fm — this message updates when it's done.
lastfm.indexed: {tick} Updated **{count}** artist(s) from **@{handle}** for this server's boards.
lastfm.indexed_uptodate: {tick} Nothing to update — all **{count}** artists from **@{handle}** are already indexed for this server's boards.
lastfm.indexed_empty: {warning} Nothing to index yet — Last.fm has no top artists for **@{handle}**. Scrobble a few tracks and run this again.
lastfm.err_not_configured: {settings} Last.fm isn't configured on this bot — the owner needs to set `LASTFM_API_KEY`.
lastfm.err_key: {settings} Last.fm rejected the bot's API key, so nothing can be read until it's fixed. The owner needs to check `LASTFM_API_KEY`.
lastfm.err_busy: {warning} Last.fm is rate limiting the bot right now — give it a few seconds and try again.
lastfm.err_unknown: {cross} Last.fm couldn't find that account, artist or album.
lastfm.err_unknown_account: {cross} Last.fm doesn't recognise the linked account any more — it may have been renamed or deleted there. Link it again with `/fm link`.
lastfm.err_unknown_artist: {cross} Last.fm doesn't know an artist by that name. Check the spelling, or use the name exactly as it appears on last.fm.
lastfm.err_unknown_album: {cross} Last.fm doesn't know that album. Check both names — `/fm album` expects `Artist - Album`.
lastfm.err_unreachable: {warning} Last.fm isn't answering right now — try again in a minute.
lastfm.err_generic: {cross} Last.fm turned that request down. Try again in a moment.
lastfm.err_unexpected: {cross} Something went wrong on our side there — that's on us, not on you. Try again in a moment.
